biography.value: Wrath Fiends are the Negative plane's embodiment of destructive fury given form and scale. They do not have tactical plans. They have targets. A summoner who gives one a target designation and stands back will find it converges on that target with single-minded effectiveness, using Devastating Charge to open, Devastation Strike to deal structural damage, and Infernal Roar to scatter anything trying to assist. Unstoppable Fury means control effects that would neutralize other summoned creatures simply do not work on them. The permanent Strength reduction at Margin 3 is the detail summoners should brief their allies about before the engagement — a target who has been hit at Margin 3 by a Wrath Fiend is permanently diminished until they can access Major Restoration. A summoner who deploys one against an enemy that matters should expect that enemy to have a lasting problem regardless of how the broader fight resolves.

system.attacksNotes:
Devastation Strike [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 Negative damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 Negative damage; target knocked Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn; no save.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 Negative damage + Prone + Stunned; target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or loses 1 point of Strength permanently until they receive Major Restoration.

Infernal Roar [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, releases a roar of pure destructive fury in a 30-foot cone. All creatures in range make a Will save (compare Agil 5 + Intimidate 6 targeting vs. save).

  • Margin 1:: Frightened for 1 round.
  • Margin 2: Frightened for 1 minute; Will [Easy] save each round to end.

Net 3: Cowering until end of their next turn, then Frightened for 1 minute.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Unstoppable Fury: The Wrath Fiend cannot be Stunned, Dazed, or Charmed. Devastating Charge: If the Wrath Fiend moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target before attacking, subtract 1 from both attack dice on that attack. On Margin 2+, the target is also pushed 15 feet and knocked Prone regardless of size. Wrath Aura: Creatures within 15 feet that are not Fiends make a Fortitude [Easy] save at the start of their turn or gain the Frightened condition until they move outside the aura. Blood Frenzy: When the Wrath Fiend reduces a creature to 0 HP, it regains 10 HP and may immediately move up to half its speed as a [Free] action. Resilient Defense (1/day): When the Wrath Fiend fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
